source.snippet: I am trying to use this relatively new feature, but VS code does not like it and the code does not compile when deploying. I get errors like Unexpected symbol '\r', was expecting '\n' and Expecting ';' but was: ',' — Salesforce developer trying to use Apex multi-line string literals in VS Code, blocked from deploying due to tooling incompatibility with a recently released language feature.

problem_statement: Salesforce developers cannot use newly shipped Apex language features (multi-line string literals) because the VS Code Salesforce extension and deployment toolchain do not yet support them, causing compile errors and blocking deployments in production workflows.
target_segment: Salesforce Apex developers at companies using VS Code and the Salesforce CLI for deployments
notes: Business context: Salesforce devs are paid professionals at companies; deployment blockers have real cost. Single signal but the pain pattern (IDE lagging behind language releases) is a known recurring problem in the Salesforce ecosystem. A tool or extension layer that bridges new Apex syntax for older toolchain versions could command a subscription from dev teams.
